## Data Pre-processing
```{python}
#Import packages
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

#Utils
import src.utils.runtime as util
import src.utils.network as net
import src.utils.pp_categorical_encoding as cat_enc
```

Load runtime settings
```{python}
settings = util.load_settings()
```


### Load the data
From the sandpit data

```{python}
df_base = net.load_features(
    settings, filters=["pid", "nhs_pseudo", "ccr_lower", "ccr_upper"])

#Remove columns not planned to be used as features
df_base.drop(["admission_date", "hrg_code", "date_full"], axis=1, inplace=True)
```

### Split into test and train sets
Do the split (80:20)
```{python}
target = "los"

features = list(df_base.columns)
features.remove(target)

X = df_base[features]
y = df_base[target]

strat_y = df_base.copy()[["los"]]
strat_y["y_group"] = np.where(strat_y["los"] == 0, 0, 1)
```

```{python}
# using the train test split function 
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X,y , 
                                   random_state=0,  
                                   test_size=0.2,  
                                   shuffle=True,
                                   stratify=strat_y["y_group"]) 
```
Account for sample imbalance (somehow)
(Used startified sampling to ensure even distribution of 0 los and non-0 los)

```{python}
print(y_train.value_counts()[0])
print(y_test.value_counts()[0])
```

#Specify configuration for the categoric encoding

#List all features that are categorical

    "provider_code",

    "patient_gender", 
    "patient_ethniccat", 
    "pod_intended",
    "admission_method", 
    "admission_source", 
    "date_year", 
    "date_month"
    ])

#Apply one-hot encoding to all categorical columns
df_catenc = cat_enc.apply_onehot(df_catenc, categorical_columns)
